messages:
Ravi (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — focused on customer wins/losses. I'll capture the top themes and proposed follow-ups. Please add one-line notes.
Lena (VP Customer): From CS perspective: Win = healthtech startup because of our audit-ready logs + dedicated capacity pledge. Loss = telco customer wanted on-prem deployment and strict encryption-at-rest controls.
Omar (Sales Engineer): Telco cited two blockers: no turnkey HSM/KMS integration and lack of a clear e2e validation checklist. They asked for a SOC2-like package + sample audit answers.
Ellen (CEO): Noted. We need a prioritized list: 60-day fixes vs roadmap items. What's the smallest set of deliverables that remove 70% of enterprise friction?
Ravi (Product): Early synthesis: 1) KMS/HSM customer-managed keys (core ask) 2) Audit-ready logs & retention options 3) Clear latency SLAs for Dedicated 4) Deployment packaging (VPC + air-gapped guidance). Those cover most losses.
Lena (VP Customer): Anecdote: during the demo, prospects commented that our Dedicated docs were too scattered. A concise "enterprise checklist" would help sales 1-2 stage faster.
Omar (Sales Engineer): Also technical note: one of the wins hinged on per-route model pinning + fallback policy. Call that out as a competitive differentiator in the one-pager.
Sofia (Legal): For attestation requests: we can provide a scoped attestation but need Product + Security to define the scope and timeline. Suggest a template attestation for sales to use, with expiration.
DevOpsBot: CI deploy finished: infra/prod-monitoring#412 deployed (perf tracing + extended retention toggle).
Ravi (Product): Action items proposed: - Omar: compile top 10 lost deals and map blockers (due 72h). - Lena: draft enterprise checklist one-pager (sales-friendly) by next Tue. - Engineering (checkout @integrations): feasibility doc on KMS/HSM + timeline (60d target). - Security + Legal: attestation template + approval flow.
Lena (VP Customer): I'll add two customer quotes to the checklist to make it concrete.
Omar (Sales Engineer): Will pull deal notes and include specific compliance asks (retention windows, key custody).
Ellen (CEO): If KMS is the major blocker, consider a temporary managed service where legal signs a specific addendum. But we should aim for customer-managed keys long-term.
Ravi (Product): I'll schedule a 30-min sync Friday to review the compiled blockers and draft ownership. Invite list: Product, Sales, CS, Infra, Security.
Sofia (Legal): Ping me before the Friday sync if you want the attestation template in draft.
Team: +1
Ravi (Product): Thanks all — I'll post the consolidated notes and GH project link here once created. Please keep replies short so we can move fast. :rocket:
